text: Hi, following up from our call on Tuesday. The budget is approved, around 8 lakh, and we need it live before Diwali. Four people on our side will be involved. Let me know the next steps and what you need from us.
notes: Commercials without a project. The four people are the client's staff, not users, so P-02 stays MISSING. 'Before Diwali' is a relative date. No domain is inferable, so this case is left out of the domain accuracy.
